name: implement-authority-evidence-submission
title: Implement authority evidence submission for verification evidence commands
description: Implement authority evidence submission for verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add. Post-B-2157 main has VCP shipped (verification-context-pack.ts + handlers + smoke + doc + the envelope-side of authority-contracts.ts at 443 lines + minimal evidence-collector.ts at 47 lines). checklist.ts is clean lock-first, zero authority. This story ADDS the submission half: new files authority-client.ts and authority-mode.ts; new smoke tests authority-client-smoke, authority-evidence-flow-smoke, verification-evidence-authority-handler-smoke; new package scripts test:authority-client / test:authority-evidence-flow / test:verification-evidence-authority-handler; checklist.ts wiring for verification_evidence_add and batch_add. Additive extension of main's authority-contracts.ts and evidence-collector.ts is allowed but TIGHTLY BOUNDED per user 2026-05-21: only NEW submission protocol types + helpers may be added; B-2157-shipped VCP digest / normalization / pack behavior must remain byte-identical (digestCanonical, digestCommand, digestVerificationContextPack, normalizeVerificationContextPack, buildTargetBoundEvidenceEnvelope, prepareEvidenceEnvelopeForSigning, parseVerificationContextPackContract, canonicalJson, all VerificationContextPack* / EvidenceEnvelopeContract* schemas, existing EvidenceMaterial / EvidenceCollector behavior — all untouched). ANY failure of `test:verification-context-pack-smoke` or `test:process-fact-contract` is treated as a hard blocker (REVIEW→TEST blocked, must roll back to DEV). Four hard invariants from user review: (1) local validation completes before any authority POST; (2) any local validation failure leaves authority server at 0 POSTs; (3) shadow mode = warning only, no local evidence side effect; (4) enforce mode failure = no local/remote fact divergence. Source for naming/shape: stash@{3}'s authority subset, reference-only — checklist.ts is REWRITTEN per the invariants, not cherry-picked. Out of scope: VCP files, stash@{2} VCP migration, any non-additive change to authority-contracts.ts or evidence-collector.ts, any change to existing post-B-2157 behavior when authority mode is off.
